Class PNMImageReader

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.core.image.CoreImageReader
icyllis.arc3d.core.image.PNMImageReader
public class PNMImageReader extends CoreImageReader
PNM image reader supporting P1-P6. 
P1  Portable Bitmap     ASCII (Plain)   1-bit  (0/1 per pixel)
P2  Portable Graymap    ASCII (Plain)   8/16-bit gray
P3  Portable Pixmap     ASCII (Plain)   8/16-bit RGB
P4  Portable Bitmap     Binary (Raw)    1-bit  (packed, 8 pixels/byte)
P5  Portable Graymap    Binary (Raw)    8/16-bit gray
P6  Portable Pixmap     Binary (Raw)    8/16-bit RGB

    • readData

      public void readData(ByteBuffer dst) throws IOException
      Reads the raster data as-is.

      Calling this method will update dst's position and limit.

      Note for binary formats, byte order should be big_endian, but dst's order is ignored, caller should reinterpret it as big_endian, or use readRowData(ShortBuffer) to convert endianness. For ASCII formats, dst's byte order is used.

      Row bytes is the minimum row bytes, for custom row bytes, call readRowData(ByteBuffer) instead.

      Throws:
      IOException

    • readRowData

      public void readRowData(ByteBuffer dst) throws IOException
      Reads the raster data of the next row as-is.

      Calling this method will update dst's position and limit.

      Note for binary formats, byte order should be big_endian, but dst's order is ignored, caller should reinterpret it as big_endian, or use readRowData(ShortBuffer) to convert endianness. For ASCII formats, dst's byte order is used.

      Throws:
      IOException

    • readData

      public void readData(ShortBuffer dst) throws IOException
      Reads the raster data as-is.

      Calling this method will update dst's position and limit.

      This method only works for 16-bit graymap and pixmap. Dst's byte order is used.

      Row bytes is the minimum row bytes, for custom row bytes, call readRowData(ShortBuffer) instead.

      Throws:
      IOException
